description: 静岡県の管理施設-道路案内標識(政令指定都市除く) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡県. 静岡県が管理する道路案内標識のデータです。 静岡市、浜松市のデータは含まれておりません。. Coverage: 静岡県. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡県. Its tags are 国土交通データプラットフォーム. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2024-10-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
